popCulture.title: Agamemnon (play)
popCulture.creator: Aeschylus
popCulture.description: The first play of the Oresteia — Clytemnestra's axe in the bath still defines how tragedy stages a homecoming murder.

popCulture.title: Oresteia
popCulture.creator: Aeschylus
popCulture.description: The trilogy that begins with Agamemnon's death and ends in Athenian justice — Western drama's founding blood-cycle.

popCulture.title: Clytemnestra
popCulture.description: The queen who waits with the net and the blade — Agamemnon's murder forever wears her name.
